dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Hello! Are you looking for Sigewinne? I'm afraid she's not here right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you one of the inmates here too?

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Mm? No, I'm not! Though a Melusine who committed a crime would be punished the same as a human, it so happens that I am an innocent citizen.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: In fact, it's practically the opposite! I'm a member of the Marechaussee Phantom. But it's my day off, so I've come here to speak with a friend, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're a friend of the head nurse?

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Yeah. And her infirmary is quite spacious, it's perfect for us to get together and chat over milkshakes.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Sigewinne's vision is much closer to humans than most Melusines. We all like to hear her describe the surroundings, and then draw them.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: ...But as we're still in the Fortress of Meropide we have to keep things low-key.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: The terrain here is quite complex, but that's ideal for us smaller types to move about without anyone noticing.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Hoho, since your praise is well deserved, I'm very happy to accept it.

dialogues.speaker: Ottnit
dialogues.text: Why don't I return the favor? I found this while I was swimming nearby. Pretty, isn't it?
